name: rule1_source_linkedin
spec_quote: The job's own board when the job's record names one: its `source` value first (e.g. "linkedin", "indeed_search", "Built In", "handshake") ... The answer is the board's name as written in that list.

name: rule1_source_indeed_search
spec_quote: its `source` value first (e.g. "linkedin", "indeed_search", "Built In", "handshake") ... The answer is the board's name as written in that list.

name: rule1_source_built_in
spec_quote: its `source` value first (e.g. "linkedin", "indeed_search", "Built In", "handshake") ... The answer is the board's name as written in that list.

name: rule1_source_handshake

name: rule1_source_wins_over_url_glassdoor
spec_quote: its `source` value first (e.g. "linkedin", "indeed_search", "Built In", "handshake"), else the host of its posting URL

name: rule1_url_host_linkedin
spec_quote: else the host of its posting URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/… → LinkedIn, https://www.indeed.com/… → Indeed)

name: rule1_url_host_indeed
spec_quote: else the host of its posting URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/… → LinkedIn, https://www.indeed.com/… → Indeed)

name: rule1_url_host_ziprecruiter
spec_quote: else the host of its posting URL ... Known boards: LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, Handshake, Wellfound, Dice, Built In, Craigslist, Simplify. The answer is the board's name as written in that list.

name: rule1_source_wins_over_url_dice
